dedupe_keys.name: ancillary services from distributed energy sources

description: ISGAN Working Group 6 and colleagues document this resource through an ISGAN report deposited in Zenodo. The completed SmartNet platform couples physical networks, market clearing and ICT behaviour to compare TSO-DSO coordination schemes and ancillary-service procurement. The developers’ institutional report metadata confirm implemented simulation blocks for aggregation/disaggregation, responsibilities and market/bidding dynamics, including market frequency, latency and time horizon. It was used for hypothetical 2030 scenarios representing Italy, Denmark and Spain. These are simulated future conditions, not observations of those countries in 2030. The related ISGAN report is a descriptive route to the platform and includes a separate country survey; the survey is not treated as downloadable model inputs. The inspected metadata do not establish public code, implementation language or the software licence. The report is openly available under CC-BY-4.0; these terms do not establish a software licence or public source-code release. Full descriptive metadata and file inventories were inspected. The PDF and any code or data bodies were not opened, and the calculations were not reproduced.
